label: digit 3 input late in the original phase (position >= 5)
explanation: Fires whenever the input token is the digit 3 at original-phase position 5 or later (orig_idx 5-8), with essentially perfect precision and recall. Magnitude grows with position: about 0.3 of max at orig_idx 5, about 0.6 at 6, about 0.8-0.96 at 7, near max at 8. Does not fire on 3 at positions 0-3 (only a trace ~0.02 at position 4), on any other token, on the delimiter, or in the copy phase (only faint residual activations when 3 is fed back during copy right after a strong original-phase activation).

issues: Minor: the explanation reports test recall and F1 of 1.0, but they are actually 0.9996 and 0.9998, with mass recall 0.99998. That is just rounding.

The 12 test misses carry about 0% of the activation mass. They fall into two groups: faint position-4 hits on the digit 3 (about 0.02-0.03), and faint copy-phase hits (about 0.02-0.06) when a 3 is fed back after the same 3 fired strongly in the original phase. Both groups are already disclosed in the explanation. There are no false positives on either split.

Magnitude growth is consistent with the mass shares. Mean activation per active step rises about 1 : 2.0 : 2.8 : 3.1 across positions 5 through 8, while the firing rate given a 3 stays flat at 0.034 for each position. This supports 'magnitude grows with position'.
